_readme.en: Owner: Set C with Mohammed. Arabic register: simple Modern Standard Arabic, one register for every machine; Viking sounds older and slower. Each line is one breath, under 12 English words. Every line is final text from STORY.md section 3, checked against facts.json -> missions. ch3_grounded is a copy of ch3_goodbye, kept only because src/chapters/sky.js still asks for ch3_grounded; delete it once the chapter uses ch3_goodbye. who = lrv | opportunity | viking | ingenuity | pioneer. emotion = curious | happy | scared | sad | sleepy.

ch1_dust.en: I'm sorry. I'm making a mess.

ch1_fixed.en: You fixed me. With a map!

ch1_left_behind.en: Oh. I was only for the ride.

ch2_intro.ar: تسعون يومًا. هذا كلّ ما طلبوه.
ch2_intro.en: Ninety days. That's all they asked.

ch2_orion.ar: سمّوا هذه الفوهة باسم مركبة هبطت على القمر.
ch2_orion.en: They named this one after a Moon lander.

ch2_viking_call.en: Who is driving around up there?
Opportunity. They gave me ninety days.

ch2_viking_call.ar: وأعطوني تسعين أيضًا. فأعطيتُهم ستّ سنوات.
ch2_viking_call.en: They gave me ninety too. I gave them six years.

ch2_viking_call.ar: هل يؤلم… حين يتوقّفون عن النداء؟
ch2_viking_call.en: Does it hurt, when they stop calling?

ch2_viking_call.ar: لا. تبقى ساهرًا. دائمًا يأتي مَن بعدك.
ch2_viking_call.en: No. You keep watch. Someone always comes after.

ch2_viking_call.ar: استرِح يا صغيري. فعلتَ أكثر مما طلبوا.
ch2_viking_call.en: Rest, little one. You did more than they asked.

ch3_intro.ar: الهواء رقيق جدًّا. هل يطير شيء هنا؟
ch3_intro.en: The air is so thin. Can anything fly here?

ch3_scout.en: Follow me. I can see the way.

ch3_crash.en: There's nothing to hold on to.

ch3_goodbye.en: Go on. You have work to do.

ch3_grounded.en: Go on. You have work to do.

ep_drift.en: I left in 1972. I never stopped.

ep_drift.ar: في العام نفسه الذي وصلت فيه عربة صغيرة إلى القمر.
ep_drift.en: The same year as a little rover on the Moon.

ep_last.ar: أسمعكم. لا أستطيع الردّ. لكنني أسمعكم.
ep_last.en: I hear you. I can't answer. But I hear you.
